visual.name: advanceDonutDarkModeEnterprise
visual.description: Interactive donut chart with category cards, optional comparisons, Top N and Others grouping, configurable center summaries, and report-palette support.

en-US.Role_Category_Description: Category or hierarchy used to create donut slices and category cards.
en-US.Role_Value_Description: Primary numeric measure used for slice size and the center value.
en-US.Role_Comparison_Description: Optional target, prior-period, or comparison measure.
en-US.Role_Tooltips_Description: Optional fields displayed in the Power BI tooltip.
en-US.Property_MinimalMode: Use donut-only mode when very small
en-US.Visual_LandingMessage: Place a category or hierarchy in Category and a numeric field or measure in Value.
en-US.Visual_NoPositiveDataMessage: The current data contains no positive values after applying the Data settings.
en-US.Visual_KeyboardHelp: Use arrow keys to move, Enter or Space to select, and Escape to clear the selection.
en-US.Warning_NegativesExcluded: Negative values were excluded because a donut represents parts of a positive whole.
en-US.Warning_AbsoluteValues: Absolute values are being used for negative data.
en-US.Warning_CategoriesGrouped: Some categories were grouped into Others or hidden by the Top N and minimum slice settings.
en-US.Warning_InvalidValues: Blank or non-numeric values were ignored.
en-US.Warning_TooManyCategories: The source contains many categories. Top N processing is applied to keep the visual readable and responsive.
en-US.Visual_HiddenContentMessage: Turn on Category cards or Donut in Format visual to display your data.
en-US.Visual_OthersThresholdExplanation: Applies to original categories, not to the combined Others slice.

dataRoles.description: Category or hierarchy used to create donut slices and category cards.
dataRoles.name: category

dataRoles.description: Primary numeric measure used for slice size and the center value.
dataRoles.name: measure

dataRoles.description: Optional target, prior-period, or comparison measure.
dataRoles.name: comparison

dataRoles.description: Optional fields displayed in the Power BI tooltip.
dataRoles.name: tooltips

minimumPercent.description: Percentage points of the positive source total before grouping: 25 means 25%. Values below this threshold, or outside Top N, go to Others when grouping is on.

sortOrder.description: Data order follows the categorical rows supplied by Power BI (not a guaranteed original Excel row order). It can match Value descending if the host already sorted by value.

responsiveBreakpoint.description: Auto switches at this host viewport width (pixels). At or above the breakpoint: Cards left; below: Donut above.

minimalMode.displayName: Use donut-only mode when very small
minimalMode.description: When both cards and donut are enabled, hide cards below 270 px width or 220 px height. Turn off to retain the responsive card layout.

imageType.description: Actual preserves the requested angles and direction. Mirror reflects the completed geometry horizontally; text remains readable.

minimumSlicePercent.description: Label-visibility threshold only; does not group data. Set 0 to label every positive slice. Small labels may move outside with leader lines.
